resources.string: Check permissions if a feature stops working. Changes made in system settings appear when you return.
Allows scanning and reading music on this device. If disabled, local tracks may become unavailable. Folders chosen separately retain their own access.
Allows playback notifications and notification lyrics. Check both the app switch and the playback notification category.
Allows lyrics to appear over other apps. Only needed when floating lyrics are enabled.
Used to read Bluetooth device and codec details. Only enable it if you need this information.
Used to discover and connect to Echo Link devices on your Wi-Fi network. Enable it when using Echo Link.
Android may remove permissions when an app is unused for a while. If you rely on ECHO, review the “Pause app activity if unused” option in its app settings. The option name varies by device.
Open your device settings and find ECHO to manage permissions.
